name: s1d1-tantive
description: The s1d1 router as a decision service for LiteLLM and other gateways (runs the published image).

S1D1_TIERS.description: Tier names and upper bounds your gateway sends, e.g. TRIVIAL=0.15,LOW=0.4,MEDIUM=0.7,HIGH=0.9,EXPERT=1.0

S1D1_DEADLINE_MS.description: Shed a request when its expected wait exceeds this many milliseconds.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: Optional: OpenTelemetry collector URL for traces and metrics. Leave empty for no export.

S1D1_API_KEY.description: Bearer key for the adapter routes (the app URL is public), generated for you.
